precision: CPython binary64 float; network-endian binary64 payload fixture

isolated.memory_boundary: Per-arm fresh process high-water resident set including interpreter, imports, warmup, simulator and profiling; not incremental controller allocation
isolated.profile_boundary: Separate instrumented episode; Controller.act duration and fixture serialization measured separately; not production latency
isolated.payload_boundary: Two binary64 scalar packets per coupled tick, one per one-way tick, no transport/header/network allocation; this does not prove physical communication parity

verification.boundary: Complete existing bundle verifier; includes file reads, hashing and deterministic simulator replay

limits_policy: Every included measured ceiling affects admission; satisfying ceilings does not establish paired resource parity.
timing_policy: Record all observations; no outlier deletion, idle correction, post-hoc threshold tuning or profiler-overhead subtraction.
trust_boundary: Source/runtime hashes and arithmetic consistency require an independently trusted code anchor; unsigned local timestamps and RSS are not external metrology authentication.
